description: This file defines a UI component class 'TeamStatistics' for the Mattermost system console, including related classes for stat cards, chart sections, and table sections, used in end-to-end testing with Playwright.

classes.name: TeamStatistics
classes.description: Represents the Team Statistics section in the system console UI, providing methods to interact with and verify the section's elements.

classes.name: StatCard
classes.description: Represents a statistic card element within the Team Statistics section, providing methods to verify visibility and retrieve its value.

classes.name: ChartSection
classes.description: Represents a chart section within the Team Statistics, with methods to verify visibility and check for no data state.

classes.name: TableSection
classes.description: Represents a table section within the Team Statistics, with methods to verify visibility.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the TeamStatistics container and header are visible.

methods.name: selectTeam
methods.description: Selects a team from the dropdown by name.

methods.name: selectTeamById
methods.description: Selects a team from the dropdown by ID.

methods.name: getSelectedTeam
methods.description: Returns the currently selected team name.

methods.name: toHaveTeamHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the header displays the expected team name.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the StatCard, ChartSection, or TableSection is visible.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the StatCard's value element.

methods.name: hasNoData
methods.description: Checks if the chart content indicates no data available.
